premises.text: Mobile users face poor signal, bad call quality, and prices that are too high for calls and texts
premises.evidence_span: people pay too much for their mobile phone service

premises.text: TextFree provides free unlimited texting with real mobile phone numbers on phones and non-phone devices
premises.evidence_span: TextFree lets you send free, unlimited text messages

premises.text: Text-free with voice is a SIP VoIP client that turns devices like iPod Touch and iPad into phones for free calls
premises.evidence_span: Text-free with voice is a full-on SIP-based voice over IP client

premises.text: Users age ~12–26 can earn free calling minutes by downloading apps and other offers instead of paying
premises.evidence_span: you could go to our offer window, and you choose an application

premises.text: In-app texting ads monetize attention while users wait for replies; brands want young first-time brand decision makers
premises.evidence_span: We generate well over 1.3 billion ad impressions a month

premises.text: Wi-Fi enables high-quality HD audio calls where cellular signal fails
premises.evidence_span: over Wi-Fi, because it's a big, big pipe, we can use a nice codec to give you HD quality audio

premises.text: The service needs only an OS and data connection and expands via platforms, in-flight Wi-Fi, Facebook, and global markets
premises.evidence_span: all we need is an operating system and a data connection, and we could take it to other platforms easily

value.text: Free unlimited texting and talking with high quality over 3G or Wi-Fi
value.evidence_span: never pay for a very, very high quality phone service that gives them unlimited texting and unlimited talking

causal_links.evidence_span: everything that everybody agrees on is that people pay too much for their mobile phone service
we want to make texting, and now today, talking, free
our customers could literally never pay for a very, very high quality phone service

notes: Signal/quality/price folded as one mobile-service pain bundle (§4.1.6). Dial pad/contacts/favorites/face dial cascade of phone client (§4.1.7). Traction metrics (1.7M numbers, 4B messages, profitability) excluded except as support for continuing free-text and ads mechanisms (§4.2). Offer-window minutes and ads kept as commercial facets separately revisable from VoIP product.
